# Class diagram rules

- Use `classDiagram`.
- Show 8–15 key classes (not every class in the repo).
- Include only the 2–3 most important methods/properties per class.
- Use proper UML relationships: `<|--` inheritance, `*--` composition,
  `o--` aggregation, `-->` association.
- Include interfaces with the `<<interface>>` stereotype.
- Group related classes logically.
